rv.q: From that contemplative opening line to the last notes of the raucous encore megamix, this Mamma Mia! is a perfect "welcome back" for theatergoers who have spent the last eighteen months bemoaning the industry's shutdown.
Justin Brill has created a fresh and buoyant interpretation of a musical whose strength is in its bouncy jukebox score.
Music Theater Works has picked the PERFECT show for bringing us back to the theater!

cn.t: Critics largely embrace this joyful production, praising its exuberant energy, talented diverse cast, and faithful staging of the ABBA jukebox hit, though one veteran theatergoer finds it doesn't quite match the best local versions.
